arrive.text: A room full of typewriters, and a monkey at each one.

typing.text: They hit the keys at random. They will never stop.

ask.text: Given forever, could they type Shakespeare?

page_1.text: A word. Just one, by pure chance.

page_2.text: Two words, in the right order.

found.text: There it is. To be, or not to be.

found_2.text: Given forever, it had to happen. But none of them meant a word of it.

leave_end.text: Most of it is noise. Forever is longer than it sounds.
